about: mutate-spec holds a kept verdict to what its runs read as it was before the first run began: it takes the start once, passes it to every spec, keeps nothing when a traced call names a path it cannot place, merges every run's found paths (the checkout's and the outside ones), leaves each run's own gitdir out, and says why a verdict was not kept. Run: mutate-on-target.py TREE mutate-spec.py tests/test_spec_cache.py tests/mutants/jpt-as-it-was-on-mutate-spec.json

mutants.name: no start taken
edits:
begun = spec_cache.start(root) if os.environ.get("MUTATE_CACHE_DIR") else None
    begun = None
mutants.target: first run: every one killed, run, and kept

mutants.name: the start not passed to the specs
edits: run_spec, root, sp, outdir, base, only, pool, begun)
run_spec, root, sp, outdir, base, only, pool)
mutants.target: first run: every one killed, run, and kept

mutants.name: a line it cannot place ignored
mutants.target: a traced call it cannot place: passes, nothing kept, and it says which line

mutants.name: found paths not merged across runs
mutants.target: an outside file a run found, removed by a later run: passes, nothing kept, and it says which

mutants.name: the checkout's found paths dropped
edits:
return repo, ext, {*found_repo, *found_ext}
    return repo, ext, {*found_ext}
mutants.target: a file in the checkout's .git a run found, removed by a later run: nothing kept, and it says which

mutants.name: a run's own gitdir read as an input
edits:
skip = (work, tempfile.gettempdir(), *([gitdir] if gitdir else []))
            skip = (work, tempfile.gettempdir())
mutants.target: kept, its reads with no path under any run's gitdir

mutants.name: why a verdict was not kept left unsaid
mutants.target: the checkout edited while its runs ran: passes, nothing kept, and it says why
